asked.item: Does the Viral AI Coach accept .mov files?
Does the Viral AI Coach accept only mp4 files?

verdict.reason: The sentences give the Viral AI Coach's upload size limit (100MB) but do not state which file formats the coach accepts; the format lists (MP4, MOV, WebM) belong to publishing media requirements for TikTok, Pinterest, and Bluesky, not to the coach.
